hotel_name: The Oakland Plaza Hotel Nehru Place

positive_snippets: Offering a blend of modern style and homely warmth, this property makes for a comfortable and reliable stay in the city. The rooms are spacious, neatly designed, and well-kept, ensuring a restful experience whether you’re here for work or leisure. Attentive staff add a personal touch with their courteous service, making guests feel well looked after. Its central location provides easy access to shopping, dining, and attractions, while the calm interiors create a pleasant retreat after a busy day. A well-balanced choice for travelers who value both convenience and comfort.

I was so skeptical while booking since most other reviews felt like fake, but it's a decent place for the price. No complaints from the room regarding cleanliness, no smell and the room size was also fairly well.
negative_snippets: The location of Oakland Plaza Hotel is convenient, but the rooms are quite old and in need of proper maintenance. Unfortunately, there were visible stains on the bed linen as well as in the bathtub, which affected overall comfort and hygiene. With renovation and better housekeeping standards, the stay experience could improve significantly.

There is no difference between standard room and premium room in your hotel. But You are selling the same room with high charge as premium room. This is the main conflict, should not be experienced by any guest.
There is no inhouse restaurant. But the amount you are charging, there should be ease of access of every amenities.

I stayed at this place for a night hoping for atleast hygiene and cleanliness which was in absence, It was a really poor experience with the gotel being understaffed and not good response from the management. The bedsheet and pillows had black stains and were changed after calling for 1-2 hours in the night time. The flush button was looking melted and everything looked old and not well maintained. The wooden flooring had cracks and water filled with fungus, because of the water leaking from the washroom jet washer. It’s a terrible stay at expensive price plz avoid staying here
